# IDS conformance subset

Unmodified copies of test cases from the buildingSMART IDS repository,
`Documentation/ImplementersDocumentation/TestCases/<facet>/`, at commit
`870f9c4e6e8f414e737b4d84ca1aa9b46fc6c8f3` (https://github.com/buildingSMART/IDS).
Files are renamed `<facet>__<original name>`; their content is unchanged.

(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/4.0/).

The `pass-` / `fail-` prefix is the expected outcome. `tests/test_ids_conformance.py` checks that the adapter agrees with it.
